games.summary: Essen, 1807: Grow your family business into an industrial conglomerate. Trade, manufacture, and invest in new technology. In this turn-based business and family simulation, you’ll guide your dynasty through wars and crises until 1933—and decide who will carry on your life’s work.

games.name: 7 Shifts in Subway
games.summary: 7 Shifts in Subway is a first-person psychological horror game where you play as a night train driver on what should have been a normal shift.You drive through the subway at night, stop at stations, let passengers in, and watch what happens inside the cars.But not every passenger is human.Some look almost normal.Others are wrong from the moment you see them.The subway has rules you must follow. These are not just safety rules. They are the only way to survive the night.Each shift becomes more tense as you try to understand what is happening around you. You need to watch the passengers, remember the rules, and make the right decisions before it is too late.Survival is not about running or fighting. It depends on attention, memory, and noticing small details.Every stop is a test.Every passenger could be a threat.Every rule matters.In 7 Shifts in Subway, fear comes not only from what you see, but from what you might have missed.Follow the protocol.Watch the passengers.Don't break the rules.Try to reach the end of the line alive.

games.name: A Real Life Party
games.summary: Henry is late, as always... Guess I should just go inside. How bad could it be?

games.name: Age of Failon - Birth of the Hero
Antiutopia
games.summary: Antiutopia is a fast-paced, skill-based multiplayer FPS set in a fractured sci-fi world. Built from the ground up in a custom engine by a solo developer, it delivers classic arena gun-play, tight matches, and pure competitive action. No progression grind, no gimmicks, just skill.

games.name: Arcana Rift: Tactics
games.summary: Arcana Rift: Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game where Swords, Wands, Cups and Pentacles become battlefield units. Recruit your forces, craft equipment, summon powerful Arcana and destroy the enemy Tower in strategic offline or online battles.

games.name: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix
Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix Soundtrack
Auto Mechanic Tidy Up
games.summary: Tidy up the auto repair shop! Sort the tools and spare parts, put everything in its place, clean off the dirt, and build a car piece by piece!

games.name: Automotive Tycoon
games.summary: Build your automotive empire from 1890 to today. Design vehicles with historical components, manage factory production lines, research 50+ technologies across 7 eras, and compete in a dynamic global market spanning 130+ years of history.

games.name: Big Climb
games.summary:
BIG CLIMB is a co-op climbing game for 1-4 players tied together by one fully simulated rope.

It brings together everything we love about co-op games: a climb up a huge mountain like in PEAK, a shared rope where everyone holds on to each other like in Chained Together, goofy body physics and proximity voice chat like in R.E.P.O., and a monster that hunts whoever falls behind like in Lethal Company.

The rope catches on rocks, goes taut and holds whoever slipped - or drags down whoever didn't let go in time. The fast ones wait, the slow ones get hauled up, and nobody reaches the top alone.

games.name: Bust 10
games.summary: Bust 10 is a chaotic, family-friendly party card game blending pot betting with sabotage. Bet, bluff, and use items to outsmart rivals. When someone busts, the winner smashes them with punishment props! Single-player now; online multiplayer in development.

games.name: Carnival: Tidy Up!
games.summary: Carnival: Tidy Up! is a cozy fairground restoration sim. Recycle 75,928 pieces of junk, hunt down missing parts, and repair the attractions. Bring the amusement park back to its former glory, then sit back and enjoy the rides!

games.name: Charmosaic
games.summary: Relax with Charmosaic, a cozy, free-to-play diamond painting game. Match colors, place thousands of tiny diamonds, and watch beautiful pictures come to life. Choose from three difficulty levels and enjoy new free paintings every month.

games.name: Coding War
games.summary: Program a combat robot and send it to battle against other robots.

games.name: Defend The Wall
games.summary: Choose your hero. Kill demons. Collect gold. Build your army. Upgrade Skills. Defend the wall. In this army building incremental game, you must amass the strongest army you can to survive waves of demons and defeat the Demon Lord.

games.name: Depthline
games.summary: Go 18 floors down a quarantined building. Pick the room, watch your survivor gun down the zombies and grab the gear they drop. Merge twins into rarer items, stack class bonuses and build a loadout that can reach Patient Zero. An inventory-management roguelite where the build wins the fight.

games.name: Desktop Divinity
games.summary: Build a cozy idle kingdom at the bottom of your desktop. Recruit female followers, collect gold and faith, and summon goddesses. Watch your pixel companions stroll, dance, and pray while you grow your realm and upgrade its facilities.

games.name: Dice Tiny Town
games.summary: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.

games.name: Digging In The Desert
games.summary: You lost your hat in the middle of a vast desert and must keep digging to find it!

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary:
A brand-new sequel depicting the aftermath of the theatrical anime Expelled from Paradise. The story of Angela and Dingo begins to move once more. 

This is a full-scale visual novel that weaves a grand science-fiction vision through evocative text and immersive direction.

games.name: Eyelord Returns
games.summary: Eyelord is an intense, fast-paced, heavy metal match-3 pop 'em up. It is a relentless massacre of innocent rolling eyeballs, using a mouse, touchscreen, or game controller. Get into the flow alone, or bring a friend to the slaughter!

games.name: Ghost Girl Requiem
games.summary: Play as Haruhiko, a young man who can hear ghosts, in a five-chapter supernatural adventure. Search rooms, uncover clues through conversation, show or combine items, and fight spirits with paper talismans. The choices you make in each chapter shape the story's final ending.

games.name: GhostomVillage
games.summary: Dead, you descend into the Underworld. Only by struggling to survive can you avoid fading into nothingness. Hunt, forage, farm, labor, and trade with others to gradually establish yourself in this ghostly village, and ultimately find a way to reincarnate and return to the cycle of life.

games.name: Goshiwon
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game set in a cramped Korean goshiwon. You and your friend make fake ghost videos for views. But something that looks exactly like his costume gets one step closer every day.

games.name: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together is a cozy first-person sorting game. Put 2,304 costumes, hats and props back in their wardrobes. Play alone or with up to three friends, learn useful abilities, assemble paintings and bring the theatre back to life.

games.name: Grave Mistakes
games.summary: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.

games.name: Gravity Switch
games.summary: Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks!

games.name: Hunter Road
games.summary: Earn gold by capturing and dismantling monsters? Buy rifles at the shop? Defeated allies vanish forever? Welcome to the new standard of permadeath monster RPGs. Experience a retro, yet refreshingly addictive gaming adventure.

games.name: Idle Demon Slayer
games.summary: Gather a party of wandering heroes and follow a path of cultivation and demon slaying. Build your team with combat styles, talents, manuals and equipment, then take on haunted mountain trails, secret-realm bosses and an endless tower in this single-player Chinese fantasy idle RPG.

games.name: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price
games.summary: A high-pressure management sim where you build a defense contractor from nothing, secure contracts, expand production, manage staff and supply chains, and fight to stay ahead of cash flow, compliance, and collapse.

games.name: Jingle Janitor
games.summary: Your first night as Santa's janitor, and the elves partied all night. Sort a gloriously messy workshop until every toy part sits on its shelf, learn handy magic, cheer up the elves and save Christmas. Cozy first-person tidying, alone or with a friend on the couch.

games.name: Joe Silva: Solo Trip
games.summary: N2O Joe Silva Solo Trip is a puzzle game where the goal is to help Joe overcome obstacles, collect oranges, and rescue magic flowers to reach the final cube before the path disappears. The game features 45 unlocked levels, a minimalist visual style, and no microtransactions.

games.name: Just a Villager MMORPG
games.summary: You don't need to be a hero to protect someone's tomorrow. Set out as just a villager in this 8-bit MMORPG. Cross paths with other players, help each other, and uncover the world's secrets to the end. Play with strangers, friends, or solo. Then the Trial Tower awaits. Buy once, no subscription.

games.name: Kick The Pinata!
games.summary: Grab your trusty bat and smash piñatas in this colorful incremental game. Buy weapons, unlock upgrades, rebirth, and build your strangely arranged home. Everything is cute, everything is fine, and the piñatas are definitely not alive.

games.name: Kitsune Kart
games.summary: Race as kemonomimi yokai girls through 24 courses of Japanese folklore, from fox shrines to Raijin's thunderclouds. Drift, boost and hurl yokai mischief at your rivals to take the lead.

games.name: Linlang's Ledger
games.summary: Linlang's Ledger is an idle RPG game with an ancient Chinese trading theme. Starting as a penniless merchant, you will travel across vast countries, learn professional skills, and build connections with all sorts of people, writing a colorful business legend in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.

games.name: Loop Minesweeper
games.summary: Tired of traditional Minesweeper? Try Loop Minesweeper! Familiar rules, but the board never ends. Had enough of flat boards? Rotate a sphere and sweep mines in 3D. Want something stranger? Try negatively curved space on a Poincaré disk. Super cool.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Metal Wayfarer
games.summary: Build your mech. Break their war machines. Metal Wayfarer is a single-player action shooter where you swap weapons, torsos and legs, boost through firefights, and bring down towering bosses. Reclaim an occupied island and turn Iron Legion salvage into your next upgrade.

games.name: Mole & Ore
games.summary: Become a stylish Mole armed with a three-claw grappling hook and dig your way to fortune! Snatch valuable ores, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mining automation, and build the ultimate underground mining empire in this satisfying incremental adventure.

games.name: Mudlands Rally
games.summary:
Arcade rally racing, 80 tracks, 3 career modes, split screen multiplayer, old school racing fun.

Mudlands Rally is an arcade rally racer about throwing yourself sideways into muddy turns and competing in street races with 3 career modes with 80 and more free updates to come!

games.name: Night Concierge
games.summary: You're the night concierge in a Soviet apartment block. Check faces against the resident log, watch the cameras, and decide who gets in. The “others” hide among your neighbors, and one mistake can cost a life. A PS1-style first-person horror with multiple endings and Twitch chat voting.

games.name: NinMaki
games.summary: This is different from the general ninja game, because you will play a "ninegg", a novice ninja. There are so few skills that you can't even attack the enemy!? Take advantage of everything around you, avoid a lot of killing, collect broken scrolls, and challenge the final BOSS.

games.name: No Mercy
games.summary: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

games.name: Oh Baby Blocks
games.summary: A cosy block-swapping puzzler with knitted blocks. Swap, match and chain yarn blocks to beat 24 hat-wearing bosses, solve 80 hand-made puzzles, chase the daily board, or battle friends in local and online VS, including cross-play.

games.name: Paid Parking Simulator
games.summary: Old Gus has retired and left you his run-down two-space parking lot. Take tickets, collect every fare, keep the place spotless and deal with the town's worst drivers as you grow it, space by space, into a 135-space complex in this first-person management simulator.

games.name: Pet Pet Pet: Tidy Up!
games.summary: 3,000 sleepy pets have taken over your shop. Scoop up kittens and puppies from 150+ adorable breeds, tuck each one into its matching bed, and watch total chaos turn into a perfectly organized pet paradise. No timers. No pressure. Just pets.

games.name: Put It Away Please
games.summary: It's summer vacation, and you put the groceries away exactly as your mother's notes say. A short puzzle-horror game in a PS1-style kitchen. Don't forget to turn around.[Estimated completion time: 30 minutes]

games.name: Put Out The Sun
games.summary: Put Out The Sun is a co-op incremental game about one ridiculous job: extinguishing a star. Spit, spray and haul water as a crew of four-armed aliens, mine ice, build conveyor lines and turrets, and automate everything until the Sun finally goes dark. Play solo or with up to 6 friends.

games.name: Rampage Demolition
games.summary: Pilot an auto-firing weapons platform through swarms of machines in this top-down action roguelite. Level up and evolve weapons, trigger chain collapses, and cut the power to industrial districts across nine maps.

games.name: Reshine
games.summary:
Clean away years of dust, rust and grime to restore forgotten treasures. No management, no pressure. Just relaxing, satisfying restoration at your own pace.

Take apart, clean and bring new life to long forgotten objects in Reshine - a cozy restoration game that will take you on a journey through history, all within the safe space of your own attic.

Reshine is a chill, relaxing experience. Simple and intuitive controls, minimalistic UI, straightforward gameplay. There are no complicated systems, no management, no stress.

Listen to the rainfall, as you slowly work in a quiet attic, where the time seems to have stopped. Surrounded by relics of the past, take apart each object piece by piece. There’s no rush, you can follow your own rhythm, discovering how everything fits together as you go. With nothing to get wrong, you’re free to simply unwind and enjoy the process.

The parts need to be restored to their former glory. Clean away the dust, sand down rough edges, and gently remove the rust using a variety of tools. Pick colors that feel right for you and repaint the surface until it looks good as new. Go in any order you want and just sit back, relax and watch the object come back to life.

games.name: Return to college
games.summary: How do you define university? Beyond classes, will you shop, date, exercise, or work part-time? How will you treat roommates, classmates, and everyone you meet: friendly, warm, or cold? After graduation, study abroad, find a course-related job, or freelance? Return to university; find your answer.

In Solo racing, you can select your favorite bike and ride it on curvy tracks to improve your skills and timing. Championship mode is the competition mode where you can race against other computer operated bikes.You can choose between manual and auto speed and use your device as motorcycle’s handle to control its direction.Track your achievements and others’ through Game Center leaderboards to keep an eye on the competition. So get on your favorite bike and flip and fly through exquisite trails to try all the thrills that you always wanted to enjoy.Features:- Control bike direction through Accelerometer- Multiple bikes with speed variation- Exquisite tracks and backgrounds- Collect coins to unlock new tracks and bikes- Leaderboards and Facebook SharingSupported Devices:- The game works best with iPad 3, iPad 2, iPhone 5, iPhone 4 and 4S.

games.name: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager
games.summary: Take charge of a ski jumping nation and build a team for seasons to come. Select your squads, plan training, develop young talent and follow your athletes in 3D competitions. Your decisions shape the future of the team.

games.name: Slice of Fortune
games.summary: Slice, squeeze, and sell in this juicy incremental game. Explore new locations, gather rare fruits, craft refreshing drinks, and serve thirsty customers for profit. Unlock powerful upgrades and grow through a massive skill tree as your shop becomes busier than ever.

games.name: SoulRoad
games.summary: Rhythm racing meets vehicular combat. Drive, drift, jump and smash to the beat across rollercoaster skies, sunset canyons and trinary star rings. Master 19 distinct rides, survive pack battles, and race your friends over LAN multiplayer.

games.name: Staying at a Japanese Business Hotel
Steal & Sell Simulator
games.summary: Steal valuable goods at night and sell them for a profit during the day. Start small, grow your business, and take on bigger, riskier jobs as the police close in. Invest in your shop, unlock new opportunities, and build a more efficient operation with every successful theft.

games.name: Street Food Restaurant Owner
games.summary:
You don't need Mishelin Star to create the best restaurant in the world. Who says street food can't be delicious?

Open a real street food restaurant in your city and make it a legend. It's all for your beloved customers and let everyone come and find something tasty. Make this place trendy and watch your business grow!

Take on the role of a street food entrepreneur and master the art of food preparation, customer service and efficient management. From sourcing fresh ingredients to designing workflows. You'll need strategic planning and quick decision-making to grow your business and keep your customers happy.

Street Food Restaurant Owner is a cooking game that puts you in charge of a street food cafe. Cook delicious meals, serve hungry customers, and manage your ingredients wisely to avoid waste.

Your reputation is everything - manage your food stall, serve delicious meals and impress customers to build your brand. Every satisfied customer boosts your reputation and unlocks upgrades and new recipes. But beware - one mistake can ruin your reputation.

games.name: SwitcHead
games.summary: Two badly designed factory robots, one conveyor belt and a terrible idea: each of you controls the OTHER robot's head. Shout directions, search the drawers, crack the safes and build the order before the belt carries it away. Online co-op for 2.

games.name: The Caffeine Chronicles
games.summary: A philosophical interactive visual novel about everyday interactions

games.name: The False Alice -Retold Tale- Digital Artbook
The False Alice -Retold Tale- Original Soundtrack
The Funeral of Kay
games.summary: The Funeral of Kay is a visual novel style adventure game. Exiled noble Jun need to launch a space burial for his guardian Kay who died for protecting him. Guide him to the launch site, and reminisce about memories with Kay.

games.name: The Great Himalayan Noodle Descent
games.summary: Build a slide from the summit of Everest, all 29,031 feet of it, and send a pile of flailing noodles hurtling to the bottom. Bend, loop, and launch your way past cliffs and crevasses using real physics. How many noodles will survive the trip?

games.name: The Retrospection Of Tomorrow - Music Box
The Spectrum Retreat: Redux
games.summary:
Solve the impossible. Expose the truth. Uncover the secrets of The Penrose Hotel in this atmospheric first person puzzle thriller.

Welcome to The Penrose. Service is impeccable and the rooms are immaculate. You’re its most valued guest, but you can’t remember checking in.

The Spectrum Retreat: Redux is a first-person puzzle thriller created by Dan Smith, Winner of the 2016 BAFTA Young Game Designer Award.

You are Alex. You awaken inside The Penrose, an unsettling art-deco hotel cut off from the outside world. Its corridors are quiet, its staff endlessly attentive, and each day follows a familiar routine. Guided by the voice of a mysterious stranger, you begin searching for the truth about why you are here.

Your escape hinges on solving The Spectrum Retreat’s series of intricate logic and spatial challenges. Absorb and swap colors to slip through security barriers, redirect energy, manipulate your surroundings and rethink the rules of each space. But every puzzle solved brings you closer to something The Penrose would rather keep hidden.

Beneath the hotel’s facade lies a story of memory and grief. You’ll need to decide whether some realities are better left undisturbed.

Tilt Siege
games.summary: A pinball roguelite about holding a castle. An army marches down the table toward your keep: smash it with the ball, tilt the whole table to dump soldiers into the spikes, and build towers and bumpers between waves.

games.name: Train Sim World® 7: Cargo Line Vol. 8 - Taschenwagen
Train Station Staff Simulator
games.summary: First-person sim: work at a small, new one-line station in Japan. Open up at dawn, sort out trouble at the gates, announce delays, hit the emergency stop if someone falls onto the tracks: over 60 kinds of real station work. Even with a subway line, you're one person sharing the work with your crew.

games.name: TrapRush
games.summary: TrapRush is an online party platformer for 2 to 12 players. Each round, everyone places one item on the same course: a bridge, a spring, or a saw hidden under it. Then you all race to the flag at once. Make it while your friends don't, and you score.

games.name: Unknown Depths
games.summary: Climb down an endless, dark shaft with up to three friends. Something grows out of the rock and hunts you by scent: move fast and it smells you, stay in the light and it can't reach you. Hook, swing and rappel your way deeper. Can you reach the end before it breathes you in?

games.name: Vibe Train
games.summary: A cozy, casual train-themed desktop idle game. Explore the world by rail. Equip a variety of train cars, and grow crops, haul cargo, trade goods, and carry passengers along the way.

games.name: Voidrush (Greaver)
games.summary: Pilot your rocket through an endless 3D tunnel, from the planet's surface into space. Dodge rotating obstacles, risk a boost for extra points and beat your personal best. Play solo or challenge up to three computer opponents. German-language interface.

games.name: Weeding Together
games.summary: Pull weeds with your friends! Pluck, gather, and sell! A simple yet addictive multiplayer weed-pulling game. Work together to clear every last weed and feel completely refreshed!

games.name: Zombie Outbreak - Co-Op Edition
games.summary: Survive with your allies with up to 4-Player Online Co-Op survival and try to resist death in classic round-based zombies. Can you survive the zombie outbreak?

games.name: 1 AM MOSCOW TIME
games.summary:
Did you know that Moscow attracts mysterious magical creatures at night? Going towards the northern lights, they interfere with the city lights and are attracted to the depths of the modern metropolis.

During the day you are a designer: work, communicate with friends, and at night go to the rooftops of Moscow and accompany magical creatures.

A 2D adventure about rescuing magical creatures in Moscow and the role of a design bureau employee in this whole story.

games.name: 2D Hates 3D
games.summary: A short incremental game where you play as Commander, leading a squad of flat 2D shapes against an invasion of 3D ones. Clear timed waves, collect scrap. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from squad damage to time-bending perks. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

games.name: 3 Billion
games.summary: You have 30 seconds. You have one spark. The Source pulses to the music and unleashes more every lap, until the field overflows with light. Grab, spend, repeat. A short, intense game. First goal: 2.3 billion. Of what? That’s a secret.

games.name: Bio Inc. Total Defense
games.summary: Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game set inside your body. Command your immune system against massive hordes of viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. Upgrade your defenses, place them wisely, and fight for every inch of your body.

games.name: Blubbis Abenteuer
games.summary: German-language interactive children’s book with full German voice narration – no English version available

games.name: Boardgame Nights
games.summary: Boardgame Nights is a 3D board game collection with 16 games. Play alone or online with up to 8 players!

Now become the top guy or girl and show off your ultimate tattoos.  Own your shop and become the tattoo master, the tycoon that will leave people stunned. Show your tattoo designs to everyone. Be the talk of the town with your tattoo designs and become the top star artist you always wanted to be. Introduce the new fashion that gives everyone goosebumps. Fashion that everyone is talking about. The fashion statement that has never been made before. Even nails won’t have that many designs and options as much as your tattoos. games.name: Box Them Cats
games.summary: Box Them Cats is a cozy drag-and-drop puzzle game. Grab wandering cats, sort them into the right-sized boxes, recycle the sneaky trash bags, and take on clients’ challenges to earn goddess blessings.

games.name: Carry On Together
games.summary: Carry On Together is an online co-op moving game for up to 4 players, where you build a small delivery company with your friends and every job can turn into chaos. Break the furniture, crash the truck, lose all your earnings or hold it together as a team. Can you keep the company alive?

games.name: Clash of Crests - The Golden Spurs
Construction Site: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: The delivery truck just tipped a whole building into one giant heap. Dig out bricks, logs, steel beams and Sash Windows, check the plan and fit every part into its glowing blueprint slot. Then bin the rubbish, return the tools and watch the lights come on, solo or with your crew.

games.name: Core Valley
games.summary: Build a home, grow your farm, and follow adventure beyond your doorstep. Core Valley blends cozy farming, crafting, fishing, and animal care with underground exploration, dungeons, and boss battles. Play solo or together in LAN co-op.

games.name: Crash Protocol: The Wrong Directive
games.summary: Outsmart malfunctioning robots in a turn-based grid strategy game. Lure them into collisions, use tactical bonuses and Safe Teleport, and master 50 fixed campaign levels, endless Survival waves and a separate ASCII Classic mode.

games.name: Creator Tycoon
games.summary: Run a creator company with your own studio and production team. Combine production cards, design workflows, and furnish your workspace with equipment and housing items in this management sim. Develop your staff, grow channels, and expand through sponsorships and creator contracts.

games.name: Dear Gardener
games.summary: A quiet first-person game about honest work, kind employers with secrets, and a crow who steals.

games.name: DeathSlots
games.summary: The Rules are Simple: You must reach 1,000,000 Gold --- If you run out of gold you die!! ????

games.name: DEVILS : THE BORUTA REVENGE
games.summary: DEVILS is an arcade-logic game with rpg elements created in the retro atmosphere of Commodore 64 computers. It was created using 16 colors known from Commodore 64.  The game is available in two language versions: English and Polish.

games.name: Dog Soup
games.summary: Your significant other is coming home in a few minutes. The pot is empty. And a hungry beast is running around the house eating your vegetables. Grab them, carry them, throw them in the soup, and try not to get hit with a rolling pin!

games.name: Dragon Egg Survivor
games.summary: Survive waves of monsters as a princess knight in this top-down action roguelite. Your attacks are automatic, so focus on dodging and choosing upgrades. Protect dragon eggs until they hatch, then fight alongside your new dragon allies to defeat powerful bosses.

games.name: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots
games.summary: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a reel SPIN! Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

games.name: Duck Billiards
games.summary: Duck Billiards is a bullet heaven where your attacks are determined by billiard balls and runs are lightning quick. Play as cool duck wizards and unlock lots of items and levels!

games.name: Dusky's Nook
games.summary: Dusky's Nook is a cozy idle desktop game about a little mushroom guy living his life on a floating island, anywhere on your screen. He gathers mushrooms and head pats, levels up, and unlocks new looks for the island — and a friend or two along the way.

games.name: Embodybird
games.summary: Embodybird is a small, physics-based game with continuous bird flight controls. Decide how hard to flap, how far to spread your wings—even how wide to fan your feathers! Fly, land, hunt, and carry your catch home before dark. EMBODY THE BIRD!

games.name: Escape From Streamer House
games.summary: Trapped inside a dangerous streamer's house, you must find his computer, delete a compromising private video, and escape before he catches you. Hide, solve puzzles, explore dark rooms, and survive a terrifying game of cat and mouse.

games.name: Escape Your Boss
games.summary: An overworked accountant in a ninja suit takes on his entire company. Fight your way out of Megacorp Tower in a pixel-art action platformer, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

games.name: EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana
games.summary: A psychological exorcism horror featuring the unique Presence System and a 3D Jumpscare effect that makes demons burst out of your screen. Every sound has a source. The demon sees you, hears you, senses your fear. Forget predictable jumpscares.

games.name: For Our King
games.summary: A medieval Tower Defense x Autobattler Roguelite. Defend your Keep across escalating waves, recruit different unit types, and cast spells from different Schools of Magic. Spend what you earn on a skill tree with over 300 upgrades, and place them on a Decree Bar with many unique modifiers and mults.

games.name: Forts of Canada
games.summary: Forts of Canada is a single-player 2D strategy game about keeping eight historic Canadian forts standing. Manage supplies, recruit troops, fire the cannons, sail dangerous waters and plan battles before watching them unfold.

games.name: Grandpa Sam's adventures
games.summary: A 4-player couch co-op action platformer where Grandpa Sam and his friends are starving, so they eat a few bananas, not knowing that they belong to the Monkey King. Enraged, the Monkey King sends his minions after them. To restore peace, they must defeat him.

games.name: How Smart Are You
games.summary: The year is 3518. On a faraway planet you find a pyramid built by someone very clever, and nobody is there. Inside, 30 puzzle rooms test your IQ. Every room hides one right door, every mistake costs you points, and six pictures on the walls slowly tell you what happened here.

games.name: In Orbita
games.summary: A funny, bittersweet point & click adventure: explore your parents' house on an ordinary Sunday and the cartoons of the 80s, collect and combine items, solve puzzles and choose what to say, even when the sincere words just won't come out

games.name: Island Sort
games.summary: Pirates trashed the island! Grab thousands of scattered goods and sort them into the right crates and shelves, solo or in 3-player co-op. Unlock portal doors, uncover secrets and race a friend in 1v1 sorting duels.

games.name: KINETET
games.summary: A falling-block puzzle driven by physics. Adjust your angle and power to launch blocks that roll, tumble, and stack. Connect same-colored blocks from wall to wall to clear them, and compete with players worldwide for the high score on the online leaderboards!

games.name: Kings of Oros
games.summary: In Oros, battles are real physical interactions, not static animations. Swings carry momentum, collisions have weight. Find synergies in weapons, relics, cards, enchantments, classes and more to unleash crazy builds and try to break the game as you battle armies, bosses, and other players in PVP.

games.name: Komorebi Alchemy
games.summary: Gather materials, practice alchemy, and grow a little shop with your companions in this shopkeeping RPG. Enjoy puzzle-based crafting, workshop decorating, a café, farming, and town development as you prepare for raids. Your creations can help protect the town.

games.name: Lily Fantasia - FADING LIGHT Song Pack
Lost Camp
games.summary: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

games.name: lucky me (Jilin miaomiao)
games.summary: A live-action interactive romance. Lin Yu joins a travel dating show as its only male contestant after failing his exams. Meet four women in first person, shape relationships through dates and choices, and discover multiple endings. Is the love on camera real?

games.name: Magical Rune Tower: Sort the Alchemist Tower
games.summary: Discover an abandoned alchemy tower in the forest and reorganize it at your own pace to become its new owner. Arrange more than 2,500 randomly scattered objects using a map and ancient magical runes, unlock blocked rooms, and enjoy an experience with no time limits.

games.name: Make It Cozy
games.summary: Turn awkward spaces into welcoming homes in this relaxing interior design game inspired by Feng Shui. Arrange furniture, complete client orders, and unlock My Home — draw your own floor plan and furnish it your way.

games.name: Metal Simulator
games.summary: Start as a solo metal musician in 1970 and build the greatest metal band of all time! Write songs, release albums, recruit musicians, tour, grow your fanbase, and evolve with the changing sounds of metal across the decades.

games.name: Monster Showdown
games.summary: You play as a Reaper who was sent out to hunt down monsters who have invaded the land. Visit haunted locations filled with all sorts of strange beings. No run will be the same due to procedurally generated levels and a multitude of ability upgrades.

games.name: MUKIMUKI NYANKOS
games.summary: Online party chaos for up to 8 friends: train fluffy kittens in a neon gym until their muscles break the roof. Steal gains, suplex your friends, become a kaiju and survive laser pointers, Roombas and UFO abductions. Whoever weighs the most at 11 PM wins.

games.name: Newborn
games.summary: Newborn is a 3D online fantasy RPG for Windows where every journey begwins at the very start of a life. Create a character, step into the medieval town of Rokento, and set out across a living continent of desert dunes, frozen glaciers, misty marshlands, open seas and far-off islands.

games.name: ORYFT
games.summary: Drill through underground walls, collect resources, craft powerful drills, and fight the creatures lurking beneath the surface. Restore the Lumera-01, defeat five bosses, and test your skills in the Infinite Rift.

games.name: Paint the Town
games.summary: One morning, every color in town is gone. Grab a brush and bring it back: paint houses, cars, trees and towers until the gray city glows again. A calm, satisfying first-person incremental game — from a single brush to a paint cannon. Almost half a million square meters are waiting.

games.name: Paragra: Paragliding Adventure
games.summary: Paragra is a 2D arcade paragliding game. Climb in thermals, become an XC league hero and win competitions. Read the sky, pee in a diaper and don't land in a field too early.

games.name: Patch Zero
games.summary: You are a tiny security agent inside a hacked corporate network. Blast through server rooms infested with worms, botnets, trojans and ransomware, pick upgrades, and reach the Core Server in this fast top-down roguelite.

Restaurant Rush Together

games.summary: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

games.name: Sort It Together - The Cool Pack
Sort My Pigs
games.summary: Sort My Pigs is a 2D organizing simulator where you sort over 5,000 cute pigs into their correct pens. Pick a pig, find its pen, earn hearts, and unlock upgrades as your farm grows. No timer, no pressure, no motion sickness, just pure, cozy sorting bliss.

games.name: Starship Crafter
games.summary:
Take on the starship mechanic role and pay the immense debt your father left you with. 

Upgrade your workshop, craft components, build starships, do contracts for factions, follow the ongoing events with the daily newspaper, and most importantly, pay the debt before the deadline.

games.name: Story of The Needle In a Haystack
games.summary: They say finding a needle in a haystack is impossible. Time to prove them wrong. Clear millions of pieces of hay from an old barn, upgrade your tools, sell what you collect, and search every last pile until that tiny needle finally shows itself.

games.name: Survivors
games.summary: Survivors is a tower defense game mixed with roguelite elements. Place your survivors, test your strategy, lose, earn resources, upgrade your defenses and try again, stronger.

games.name: System Critical 3
games.summary: Step into the fast-paced, high-energy world of System Critical 3, the ultimate VR platformer-shooter designed exclusively for PSVR2. With intense gunplay, gravity-defying jumps, and mind-bending virtual environments, you’ll navigate a futuristic cyber-realm where every battle is a test of skill and reflexes. Experience ruthless boss battles, traverse dynamic landscapes, and master an arsenal of powerful weapons—all in stunning virtual reality.

games.name: Tanks & Trebuchets
games.summary: A WW2 tank in a medieval world, fighting armies of several hundred soldiers at a time and knocking down their castles. There is an open-world campaign, a Gauntlet roguelike mode, and online co-op and PvP with friends for up to four players.

games.summary: An idle fishing and aquarium game for the corner of your desktop. While you work, a small window quietly fishes for you. Collect 35 species across 10 rarity tiers, then decorate your tank with castles, rocks and coral to build the aquarium you want.

games.name: The Eggsortist
games.summary: A chicken possessed by the Devil has laid 4,266 colored eggs in a barn, but 666 of them are demonic eggs in disguise! Sort the eggs, find the evil impostors, and burn them before they hatch and doom the world.

games.name: The Endless Harvest
games.summary: Ever been to Thailand? Bangkok Betty is a new twist on an old Beer Pong favourite. Help Betty to launch her Ping Pong Balls off of the obstacles and into the Pint Glass, and remember to collect as many coins as you can while you're at it.Bangkok Betty is a fun physics and puzzle game with great re-playability.Stay tuned for more worlds in free app updates, coming very soon!

games.name: The Film Archive
games.summary: Restore order to a film archive in this cozy first-person sorting game. Inspect films, reunite numbered reels, and shelve 400 films across three floors. Unlock useful upgrades and turn towering piles of film cans into a satisfying, organized collection.

games.name: The House on Grisewood
games.summary: A top-down survival horror shooter set in a haunted manor. Explore room by room with a failing flashlight, scavenge ammunition and batteries, and fight or evade what stalks the dark. Reach the ballroom and end what laughs there, or hold out in an endless Zombie Survival mode.

games.name: Tidy Mall Together
games.summary: A cosy co-op tidying game. Sort + 4,600 runaway things back onto the shelves of 11 shops with up to 3 friends. Grab, stack and shelve, unlock magnets, scanners and sorting robots, hunt 25 golden items, play mini games and turn the messiest mall in town into the tidiest.

games.name: Tinsel Tumble
games.summary: A cozy Holiday falling-block puzzle game. Drop pairs of elves and presents into the well, land an elf beside presents of its color to wrap the lot, and set off chain reactions. Story, Endless, 50 Challenges, Daily, an Advent calendar, and couch Versus and Battle mode for up to 4 players.

games.name: Wave & Sort: The Magic Wand Shop
Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket

Hire staff, build production lines and grow a factory big enough to find the ticket, alone or with up to three friends.

games.name: Wrapuzzle
games.summary: An original game of patience and relaxation where the jigsaw puzzles only have two edges! Reassemble them and wrap them around objects of your choice to display on your shelves. Human-made unique designs. Choose between 100 and 2,000 pieces, and have fun!

In the rural Japanese town of Inaba, the once sleepy streets receive a cold wake-up call when a mysterious serial killer strikes. Also, what's with the rumor of a mysterious TV channel appearing only on rainy nights? 

A whirlwind of surprises and otherworldly adventures will make the next year of your high school life anything but ordinary!

Persona 4 Revival intertwines an investigation into a string of murders with the journey of self-discovery and encounters with the occult, all within a critically acclaimed, classic RPG experience - reborn in a new form!
